# MBC CQRS Serverless Framework — Agent Index

> TypeScript/NestJS monorepo implementing CQRS and event sourcing on AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, SNS/SQS, Step Functions, Cognito).

## Contributor reference (read first in this repo)

- [docs/agents/README.md](docs/agents/README.md) — entry point for maintainers and coding agents
- [docs/agents/package-graph.md](docs/agents/package-graph.md) — package dependencies
- [docs/agents/core/overview.md](docs/agents/core/overview.md) — `@mbc-cqrs-serverless/core` modules and flows
- [docs/agents/conventions.md](docs/agents/conventions.md) — registration patterns and pitfalls
- [docs/agents/_generated/module-service-index.md](docs/agents/_generated/module-service-index.md) — generated module/service inventory (`npm run docs:agents:gen`)

## Packages (npm)

@mbc-cqrs-serverless/core, cli, master, sequence, task, tenant, ui-setting, import, directory, survey-template, mcp-server

Per-package contributor docs: `docs/agents/<package>/overview.md`

- Full documentation: https://mbc-cqrs-serverless.mbc-net.com/
